article.story: KISSIMMEE, Fla. -- — Tyler Tejada scored a season-high 24 points to lead Cincinnati to a 70-59 victory on Friday over previously unbeaten Boston College in the ESPN Events Invitational. Tejada shot 7 of 11 from the floor, made four 3-pointers and all six of his free-throw attempts. Nine others scored for Cincinnati, which shot 51% from the field and made 18 of 22 free throws. Jayden Hastings and Elijah Perryman combined for 13 points for Cincinnati (7-1). Perryman had five of the Bearcats' 13 assists and Hasting blocked three shots. Money Williams made four 3-pointers and scored 21 points to lead Boston College (7-1). Luke Hunger added 12 points and Armoni Zeigler had 11. Colby Duggan chipped in with nine points on three 3s. The Bearcats used a 12-2 run to take a 48-38 lead with 10:55 remaining and led the rest of the way. Duggan's 3-pointer pulled Boston College to 60-57 with 3:06 left. Tejada answered with a 3 as the Bearcats ended the game on a 10-2 spurt. The Eagles missed 40 of their 57 field-goal attempts and shot 30% overall. Up next Cincinnati: hosts Monmouth on Wednesday. Boston College: at Georgia on Tuesday in the SEC/ACC Challenge. ------ Sign up for Top 25 poll alerts here, visit the Top 25 here and see AP’s full men’s basketball coverage here
